11/11 elements have identity placements (coordinates baked into vertices; insertion points lost). Emit real IfcLocalPlacement positions per element so they can be moved/rotated in Revit.
11/11 elements have no type object. Add a shared IfcXxxType per model number so Revit gets one type per catalogue item (type parameters, tags, schedules).
9 elements repeat identical geometry verbatim (528 duplicated triangles). Use IfcRepresentationMap + IfcMappedItem instancing.
Single storey and no IfcSpace: add one IfcBuildingStorey per real level and IfcSpace for rooms so Revit gets Levels and space data.
